title: Existence of an fpqc amalgamation
statement: Let k be a field, f:C to Spec k a smooth proper geometrically integral curve, d an integer, and S the fibrewise-degree-d subfunctor [lem-pd-degree-locally-constant]. For an fpqc sieve R on T and a compatible family x of sections of its fppf sheafification, an amalgamation exists.

proof.text: After a finite separable residue-field extension, the curve has a section. Normalize local invertible modules along that section; uniqueness of normalized transition maps gives the cocycle, so fpqc descent glues them. The degree condition descends by the degree base-change theorem and joint surjectivity. Compare the two pullbacks of this glued section over the double finite-field overlap by uniqueness of normalized descent; fppf descent along the finite extension then produces the amalgamation on the original test scheme.

theorem exists_amalgamation_fpqc_sheafify_picardDegree
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsProper f] [GeometricallyIntegral f]
    (d : ℤ) (S : Subfunctor (picardPresheaf f))
    (hS : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (L : (picardPresheaf f).obj (op T)),
      L ∈ S.obj (op T) ↔ ∀ t, picardPresheafDegree f L t = d)
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (R : Sieve T)
    (hR : R ∈ (Scheme.fpqcTopology.over (Spec (.of k))) T)
    (x : Presieve.FamilyOfElements
      ((presheafToSheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over (Spec (.of k))) (Type (u + 1))).obj
        S.toFunctor).obj R.arrows)
    (hx : x.Compatible) :
    ∃ t, x.IsAmalgamation t
